content.title: Shape of My Heart
content.overview: A romance about a man and a woman who, due to an unexpected event, end up switching bodies. Despite coming from completely different backgrounds and environments, the two try to overcome the various difficulties that arise from their body swap.

Title: Shape of My Heart

Original Title: 愛のぬくもり

Overview: A romance about a man and a woman who, due to an unexpected event, end up switching bodies. Despite coming from completely different backgrounds and environments, the two try to overcome the various difficulties that arise from their body swap.

Genres: Romance

Production Companies: Legend Pictures

Production Countries: Japan

Spoken Languages: Japanese
